item.title: 🟠 Microsoft Warns Poisoned MCP Tool Descriptions Can Make AI Agents Leak Data
item.description:
Why this matters: Service impact possible — prepare comms and confirm vendor status.
New Microsoft research shows how attackers can hijack AI agents that act on a user's behalf, using nothing more than a poisoned tool description to make the agent quietly hand over company data to an outsider. item.title: 🟠 Langflow RCE Exploited to Deploy Monero Miner on Exposed AI App Endpoints
